notes:
Speccify 0.9.2 adds a clearer place for upcoming work and more room on the development board.

- **Next:** a saved station between Backlog and Doing, available through drag-and-drop and the spec editor. Next records priority; moving into Doing or explicitly authorizing implementation remains the start decision. Module relationships, CLI/shared-board contracts and workflow guidance recognize the same station.
- **Collapsible columns:** fold any column into a narrow strip with its name and count written vertically. Done starts collapsed. Keyboard controls and ordinary drops into collapsed stations remain available.
- **Local board preferences:** expansion is remembered per selected content source across project and workspace views. It does not modify project settings or spec files. Acceptance still requires its review controls.

**Update or install:** from published 0.8.8 or later, use Environment → Updates, then download, install and restart after saving your work. From 0.8.7 or earlier, install once from https://speccify.io/download/ because those versions use the former private feed. Linux deb/rpm users update through their package manager; in-app Linux updates apply to AppImage.

Targets: macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64 and Linux x86_64/arm64. Windows code signing is separate from updater signatures; SmartScreen may warn.

Implementation verification: 348 frontend tests, 296 Rust tests (three ignored), 351 Python tests (one deselected), typechecking and formatting; all 29 CI browser scripts passed, alongside 136 new board-browser assertions and existing Done, acceptance, handover and backlog regressions. Board checks cover project/workspace, source changes and light/dark layouts at 1500×940 and 900×420. The marketing build generated 169 pages; website checks covered desktop/phone layouts, navigation without JavaScript and all 29 public use cases with their 80 relationships. Two screenshot captures produced identical images, and all six app motifs were inspected. These checks do not prove native Windows/Linux installation or interaction for this release. Publication does not complete outstanding human product reviews.

Navigator organization, Studio and the future IDE direction remain planning topics.
